catalyst_text: Reported positive initial Phase 2 efficacy and safety
detailed_catalyst_text: Initial clinical data from the Phase 2 ReInspire trial in PIK3CA-driven vascular anomalies showed a 60% volumetric response at 12 weeks among response-evaluable patients, with broad symptomatic improvement. The Part 1 randomized dosing cohort in adults and adolescents also demonstrated a safety profile supportive of chronic dosing and the results were presented at ISSVA 2026. These findings indicate meaningful activity across subtypes and prior therapies.
catalyst_text_evidence: Relay Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ:RLAY) ... today announced initial clinical data from the Phase 2 ReInspire trial of zovegalisib in vascular anomalies signaling the advantage of PI3Kα mutant-selective inhibition. As of the 2026-04-15 data cut-off date, in the Part 1 dose randomization portion of the study for adults and adolescents ages 12 and up, 60% of patients achieved a volumetric response at the earliest time point (12 weeks) and nearly all patients experienced symptomatic improvement at 12 weeks while maintaining a safety and tolerability profile showing the potential for chronic use. The data are being presented at the International Society for the Study of Vascular Anomalies (ISSVA) World Congress 2026, taking place in Philadelphia.

catalyst_text: Announced positive Phase 1/2 triplet efficacy and tolerability
detailed_catalyst_text: Initial dose-finding results from a first-in-human study reported efficacy and safety for the triplet in PIK3CA-mutated HR+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer previously treated with CDK4/6 inhibitors. Among 34 evaluable patients, ORR was 44% with 85% showing tumor reduction, and safety was manageable with 0% grade 3 hyperglycemia and low discontinuation rates. These findings indicate a favorable profile in a heavily pretreated population.
catalyst_text_evidence: These data are from the zovegalisib + atirmociclib + fulvestrant dose finding portion of the study. As of the 2026-04-13 data cut-off date, 69 total patients were enrolled, with 62 patients at or below the potential Phase 3 dose and 34 patients with measurable disease evaluable for response. Only two patients (3%) discontinued zovegalisib and six patients (10%) dose reduced zovegalisib due to treatment-related adverse events (TRAEs) Grade 3 hyperglycemia was 0% despite 47% of patients being pre-diabetic Objective response rate (ORR) was 44% (15/34) and was also 44% in both kinase and non-kinase patients Nearly all patients experienced tumor reduction (85%, 29/34)

drug_indication: HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer with PI3Kα mutation
catalyst_text: Presented positive Phase 1/2 data plus Breakthrough designation
detailed_catalyst_text: New Phase 1/2 results for the combination with fulvestrant in PI3Kα-mutated, HR+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer were presented, showing a median PFS of 11.1 months and a favorable tolerability profile at 400 mg BID fed. The program also holds FDA Breakthrough Therapy designation for the Phase 3 trial population, supporting expedited development. These updates strengthen the rationale for the ongoing Phase 3 study.
catalyst_text_evidence: Relay Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ:RLAY) ... today announced data from the Phase 1/2 ReDiscover trial of zovegalisib (RLY-2608) + fulvestrant at the recommended Phase 3 dose of 400mg twice daily (BID) taken with food (fed) in patients with PI3Kα-mutated, HR+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer. The data are being presented at the European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) Targeted Anticancer Therapies (TAT) Congress 2026 in Paris, France. As of the 2026-01-13 data cut-off date, among the 57 efficacy-evaluable patients at the 400mg BID fed dose, which is the recommended Phase 3 dose (RP3D): Median progression-free survival (PFS) was 11.1 months (95% CI: 7.3–13.0). Zovegalisib + fulvestrant has received FDA Breakthrough Therapy designation for the Phase 3 ReDiscover-2 trial population.

catalyst_text: Presented positive interim data at SABCS 2025
detailed_catalyst_text: The company presented a subset analysis of interim clinical data from the first-in-human ReDiscover trial evaluating the agent plus fulvestrant in PI3Kα‑mutated HR+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer. Results showed a median PFS of 10.3 months across all patients and 11.4 months in second-line patients, with ORR of 39% overall and 47% in second-line, supporting continued development. Activity was observed across subgroups, including prior SERD exposure and ESR1-mutant disease.
catalyst_text_evidence: Relay Therapeutics, Inc. ... today announced a subset analysis of interim clinical data for zovegalisib (RLY-2608) ... These data are being presented today at the 2025 San Antonio Breast Cancer Symposium (SABCS). The data cut-off date was 2025-10-15 for this analysis. The total efficacy population consisted of 52 zovegalisib + fulvestrant patients who received 600mg BID fasted and did not have a PTEN or AKT co-mutation. The median progression free survival (PFS) was 10.3 months for all patients. Among the total of 31 patients with measurable disease, objective response rate (ORR) was 39%. For second line (2L) patients, median PFS was 11.4 months and ORR was 47%.

drug_indication: PIK3CA (PI3Kα) mutant tumors, including HR+/HER2- breast cancer
catalyst_text: The efficacy data from Phase 1 presented at SABCS indicated a confirmed ORR of 39% for all patients and 67% for those with kinase mutations at RP2D, as noted on December 11, 2024.

Data from Phase 1 of the non-CCA expansion cohort, presented at the AACR-NCI-EORTC, indicated an overall response rate (ORR) of 35%, with nine out of 26 patients showing a partial response (PR), as reported on October 12, 2023.
